description: List items (rows) of a board, including their cell values. Returns all items unless limit/page are given (the API defaults to 50 per page when unpaged, so the tool pages through and concatenates). Narrow the result with search, status, priority and sort instead of fetching everything. This is the admin view; the REST endpoints of a published app take a fuller grammar, filter[column][gte], relation filters, per-field search, see get_app_spec.

archived.description: Which rows to include. Default active

excludeStatus.description: Only rows whose status is NOT one of these, comma separated, resolved like status. The way to ask for everything that is not done: excludeStatus "done" (task board) or "Completed" (a data board with that option). Rows with no status at all are kept

limit.description: Page size; omit to fetch all items

priority.description: Only rows with one of these priorities, comma separated (task boards only)

search.description: Free text; matches the row title and its text cells

sort.description: Sort by title, createdAt, updatedAt or status; prefix with "-" for descending, e.g. "-createdAt" for newest first. Anything else keeps the board order

status.description: Only rows whose status is one of these, comma separated. Matched against the board's status column by option value or label, case-insensitive: "todo,in_progress" on a task board, "Received,In Repair" on a data board whose status column lists those (get_board_schema shows the options)

name: query_items
